stage: interface engineering and no-model controls before a new Agent preregistration
edit_authority: Complete automatically derived instruction/terminator/type/expression node catalogues for the two editable symbols. No correct-node selector, answer inventory or replacement code is supplied to a model. Whole-file/function response payloads are refused.
identity: Every response binds the actual full four-file canonical source revision plus the complete query digest, language, profile, complete catalogue and trusted host scope. HIA additionally binds production Core/input digests.

hia.ordinary_ssa_fields: actual production prepare_batch/apply_batch for op/args/attrs on output-bearing instructions
hia.other_nodes: actual production apply_program_patch for instruction/terminator edits
hia.signature_insert_delete: The production patch lacks these granular actions. The adapter reconstructs the function container from exactly the selected node changes, records every rebuilt function, and sends an explicit production v2 patch. The model supplies no function body. Signature edits require the trusted host migrate policy; parameter identity/arity remain fixed.
hia.resource_admission: whole-module production ownership/type verifier, then unchanged native/VM resource gates

rust.parser: bounded finite Rust expression/type parser with actual ASCII source spans and syntactic operator anchors; both recursive descent and bottom-up AST depth are capped at 64, including else-if and iterative postfix chains; not a general Rust parser
rust.fragments: complete-consumption expression/type parsing; duplicate and overlapping ancestor/descendant edits refuse
rust.signature_policy: Parameter/return type nodes are read-only under preserve; the trusted host must select migrate, bound into the complete query. Parameter names and arity cannot be edited.
rust.context: reparse the complete reconstructed function and preserve every unselected AST span, kind and operator anchor; fragments that change outer precedence refuse and require explicit grouping
rust.bytes: ASCII only; CRLF byte positions are preserved; Unicode/comments/strings/macros/custom declarations are outside this finite profile
rust.admission: syntax proposals explicitly remain unadmitted until the same finite source admission, real rustc type/borrow checking and bounded native public observations pass; native execution requires status compiled as well as native_built, and any failed compiler identity gate prevents execution
rust.source_rewriting: only explicitly selected spans are replaced verbatim; no host repair, implicit cast or implicit parenthesis insertion

transaction: A per-session reentrant lock covers query/source reads and the entire edit/validation/receipt/commit transaction. A concurrent second old-base response sees the first committed revision and is rejected before compilation. All edits are preflighted together. Public compile/resource/functional failure leaves the complete in-memory project revision unchanged. Successful validation and receipt retention precede a single revision update. No working repository source is published.
feedback: Only source-derived syntax/admission diagnostics and existing public cases. Hidden control observations are retained separately and never become model feedback.
controls: real Rust two-file expression edits with native hidden controls
stale complete-project replay rejected before compilation
real Rust parameter/return/cast/caller type edits atomically compiled
Rust moved-owner error reaches real rustc and retains original revision
Rust public semantic failure retains original revision
Rust ownership/value nodes pass real native and hidden control cases
HIA public wrong-value control retains original revision
HIA production SSA batch passes native and hidden control cases
HIA signature/type node edits pass native and hidden control cases with explicit container rebuild
execution_location: shared available development host; LOCAL_RUNTIME_NOT_OBSERVABLE for dot
